newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian public workers strike over price hikes.
newsitem.headline: Albanian public workers strike over price hikes.

text.p: Albanian public sector workers staged a one-day strike on Friday to press for compensation for the higher prices of bread and fuel.
Union leaders said more than two-thirds of the public workforce joined the strike, including 200,000 union members in education, food, oil and transport.

"The strike has been joined by more people than we expected and this is obvious since it is their economic problems that drive them to do so," said Estref Mersinaj, head of the Independent Trade Union (ITU).
Mersinaj and Labour Minister Arlinda Ymeraj failed to reach a compromise in last minute talks on Thursday .
The Confederation of Trade Unions (CTU), heir to the communist-era unions, also joined the strike.

Prices for bread, gas and kerosene have surged 30 percent since President Sali Berisha's ruling Democrats relaxed controls in July. The price of bread has jumped to 50 leks (46 U.S. cents) a kilo from 28.7 leks.
